ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels across the entire visible ventral surface; extremely low macro-level ratio of high-intensity pixels (estimated <2%).

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow V-shaped central depression with a wide obtuse angle (estimated 120-130 degrees) and minimal vertical depth relative to lobe width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude irregular serrations present along the entire continuous trailing edge of both lobes, characterized by frequent pixel-level peaks and shallow valleys.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature originating from the median notch transitioning into a convex sweep toward the distal tips of the fluke lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Presence of multiple short, unaligned, high-contrast (white) linear pixel streaks scattered across both lobes, most prominently on the right lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Numerous thin, white linear surface abrasions/scratches are visible across the dark pigmentation of both fluke lobes.
